new: Zero-shot comparison of eight models. Top: Conservation, Motifs, Core/non-core, SV impact, Unweighted Avg Rank and Weighted Avg Rank share a marked broken axis, with a value on every bar. Native family scores are multiplied by 100 only for display. Bottom: four sorted horizontal comparisons show Conservation AUROC, SV average precision, Unweighted Avg Rank and Weighted Avg Rank, each with native values and marked breaks. Both ranks use the same one-based task percentiles against 11 fixed PlantCAD2 leaderboard baselines. Unweighted Avg Rank first averages within each family, then gives the four families 25% each. Weighted Avg Rank matches the PlantCAD2 leaderboard by weighting each task 5%, equivalently weighting family means by their task counts. Vertical-chart value labels are rotated 90 degrees; horizontal-chart value labels remain horizontal.
